title: 3D model on a turntable
description: Your .glb model turns slowly on a turntable under studio light, in real 3D (@remotion/three: React Three Fiber + three.js GLTFLoader, WebGL). With the shade cue it starts as a wireframe on clay and the finished material rises through it from the ground up: the model is built in front of you. A few words can stand next to it.

source.also: three 0.170 (MIT) with GLTFLoader, @react-three/fiber 9 (MIT). Example model: Rover by Quaternius (CC0), examples/media/model-rover.glb

props.src: your model (.glb, textures inside the file; no Draco compression)
props.wire: true: start as a wireframe and get the material at 45 % of the scene (or time it with the cue)
props.color: colour of the wireframe, the ring and the back light (teal)
props.cues: {"shade": time} when the material rises through the wireframe; {"words": time} when the words come in
